description: Sign a bundle directory with `opa sign`. A directory is signed in place: `.signatures.json` is written into it and files are recorded as `<directory name>/<file>`, so the signed directory verifies wherever it is placed as long as its name is unchanged, with `opa_bundle_verify` or with `opa build` or `opa run --bundle <name>` from its parent. An archive is refused: OPA reads the signature from inside it, so a signed archive comes from `opa_bundle_build` with `signingKey`. The key is a PEM private key (RSA or ECDSA); for HMAC algorithms pass a file holding the secret. Extra claims such as `keyid` and `scope` come from `claimsFile`. Returns the path written, the algorithm, and the number of files covered.

bundle.description: Path to a bundle directory. Must be inside an allowed root. An archive is refused, since OPA reads the signature from inside it; build a signed archive with `opa_bundle_build` and `signingKey`.

claimsFile.description: Path to a JSON file of extra claims to sign, such as {"keyid": "...", "scope": "..."}. Must be inside an allowed root.

signingAlg.description: Signing algorithm: RS256 (default), RS384, RS512, PS256, PS384, PS512, ES256, ES384, ES512, HS256, HS384, HS512.

signingKey.description: Path to the PEM private key (RSA or ECDSA), or for HMAC algorithms a file holding the secret. Must be inside an allowed root.

name: opa_bundle_sign
title: Sign OPA bundle
